turns.title: Create the short opening proof
turns.newAction: The four pieces are offered fare already lying on the counter. Dolo looks from the credits toward the implied customer just beside the lens, gives a restrained businesslike half-smile, then lowers his gaze toward the money. His character-right index finger comes to rest above the first piece, ready to count. End there; do not already complete the transaction.
turns.expectedEndState: Poised to start the first count; all four credit pieces remain in the original row.

turns.title: First count — the actual continuation test
turns.newAction: Dolo uses the poised index finger to touch each of the same four credit pieces once, in row order, without picking them up. He makes four distinct, unhurried touches, then withdraws the fingertip slightly. The four pieces remain separate and stationary.
turns.expectedEndState: First count completed; same four pieces and same seated blocking.

turns.title: Strictly business
turns.newAction: Dolo raises his gaze from the counted row toward the same off-camera customer. Hold a brief skeptical look and a subtle head tilt, conveying that the price is firm. His hands stay beside the same four pieces. No spoken words or lip-synced performance.

turns.title: Count it twice
turns.newAction: Dolo looks down and checks the SAME four credit pieces a second time, touching each once in the reverse row order. This is a recount of existing money, not a second payment. End with his finger lifted clear; no extra pieces appear.
turns.expectedEndState: Second count completed; four pieces total, unchanged identity/set.

turns.title: Make the offered payment neat
turns.newAction: Dolo gently nudges the edges of the same four pieces into one straight, evenly spaced row. Keep each piece visible, with only small sliding movements on the counter; do not stack, transform or replace them. End with hands relaxed beside the row.
turns.expectedEndState: Four pieces aligned; no teleporting or duplication.

turns.title: Fuel costs extra
turns.newAction: Dolo glances once toward the existing dim fuel-status area established in the starting frame, then back toward the customer. If no such indicator was established, glance toward the same fixed console instead; do not invent a new display now. Raise one index finger briefly as a matter-of-fact fee reminder. Credits remain untouched.
turns.expectedEndState: One-finger fee gesture settled; four credits unchanged.

turns.title: Payment before passage
turns.newAction: Dolo lowers the raised finger. He uses the flat side of one hand to draw the same four aligned credit pieces a short distance toward his side of the counter, keeping them visible and separate. The pieces move by contact, not by disappearing beneath his hand. Stop once the row is closer to him.
turns.expectedEndState: Payment drawn closer to Dolo; all four pieces visible.

turns.title: You are buying a ride
turns.newAction: With the other hand, Dolo gives one small directional gesture toward the existing offscreen entrance, granting passage only after taking the payment. His seat, torso and camera position stay fixed. No new customer, doorway view, location or cut appears. The four credits remain where turn 07 left them.
turns.expectedEndState: Small passage gesture completed; transaction geography unchanged.

turns.title: Nice try
turns.newAction: Dolo rests both hands near his side of the counter and gives the customer a brief knowing half-smile, as if dismissing an attempt to get a free extra. Keep the mouth restrained; when teeth show, preserve exactly four gold upper caps (both lateral incisors and both SHORT canines), two natural white central incisors and natural other uppers, the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lip hoops and original nostril placement. He is still mercenary, not suddenly heroic.
turns.expectedEndState: Restrained smile settles; four credits still on his side.

turns.title: Close the opening beat
turns.newAction: Dolo lets the smile fade to calm confidence and turns his attention slightly toward the ship console without getting up. The four luminous credits remain clearly in frame. Finish with a short natural settle suitable for an editorial cut; do not loop, fade, add text, start a chase, introduce a boss or move into the later rescue story.
turns.expectedEndState: Stable end pose; opening payment beat complete.
